title: Read-order sensitivity
warning: Specification only; not an executable benchmark configuration. No shuffles or assemblies have been generated.

pilot.input_policy: Reuse the same frozen read set; freeze each permutation once and reuse identical bytes for its repeats.

input_admission: Identical complete FASTQ record multiset, including duplicate multiplicities, names, sequences and quality strings.
Distinct verified order-sensitive record digests for original and shuffled orders.
Original compressed-file provenance plus per-order compressed-file hash, multiset hash, order hash, shuffle seed and implementation version.
primary_endpoint: Output-to-output sequence agreement, independent of reference recovery.
comparison_levels: Repeated outputs within each fixed input order
Outputs between different orders within a fixed tool/version/mode/thread setting
normalisation: Ignore output names, order and strand; retain duplicate contigs. Report end-sensitive and independently circular-normalised representation comparisons separately. Do not condition primary equivalence on reference matches.
verdicts: Within-order variability; order-specific effect not established
Not assessed: incomplete execution or unverified input equivalence
implementation_gates: Validate full-record permutation and multiplicity-preserving input equivalence checks.
Validate reference-independent output comparison, including circular representation and ambiguous topology cases.
Validate grouping and report denominators; reference recovery must not determine the S7 verdict.
